services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: Join us on Kelowna's only floating Tiki Boats. Our Okanagan Lake cruises are the perfect way to relax and swim without the crowds. Enjoy your Tiki adventure on the glistening crystal waters of Okanagan Lake. Let your imagination run wild! The "Private Tiki Cruise" allows you to take control and design your perfect day or evening. If you want to get the most out of your Cruising Tiki experience, this is the charter for you. We are open to any ideas or special events you might have. Your Captain will give you a local perspective of Kelowna cruising fun. services.name: Pontoon Boat Tours
services.desc: Getting your day trip or vacation started is very exciting! We totally understand as we can't wait to host you on our Pontoon Boat. You will meet your Captain at our downtown Kelowna dock. Our experienced Captains will take you around the lake, making stops to cool off by jumping in for a swim. Don't forget we also have a fun tow behind tube that will whisk you around the lake. All of this while you are listening to awesome tunes taking in some of the most beautiful scenery in Canada being envied by everyone on shore! PONTIKI COMBO! services.name: Bike Rentals
services.desc: Experience a part of BC’s history; bring your camera and leave your worries behind as you are guided through this Hidden Jewel of the Okanagan. ‍Have fun with the entire family cycling all, or part of this well-established 24 km circuit. The interactive trail can be cycled in 4 hours at a moderate pace with plenty of opportunity for photos and short breaks. Bicycles are available for children and adults, as well as equipment for the young ones starting at 7 years old. Our shuttle takes you up to Myra Canyon and the Kettle Valley Rail Trail and brings you back to your hotel. services.name: Flyboarding Tour
services.desc: Flyboarding is the most exciting new sport on Okanagan Lake. Strap on this water powered jet pack and fly through the air above the water. It is perfect for all ages and can be enjoyed by skill levels. Always wanted to try fly boarding, but no one to go with? We got your covered! Jump in solo and meet some other like-minded new friends or bring another friend along or the whole family. This experience is suited for anyone looking to learn this fun, new water sport. Add It To Your Tiki Boat Tour. At the end of your tour we can meet your group at the dock for an exciting flyboarding experience to finish off your day.
